title: Building an AI Agent With LangGraph and Python
description: Learn LangGraph in Python with this hands-on video course and build a stateful AI agent using state graphs, nodes, and conditional edges.
summary: LangGraph is a versatile Python framework designed for stateful, cyclic, and multi-actor Large Language Model (LLM) applications. LangGraph builds on its parent library, LangChain, and allows you to build sophisticated workflows that can handle the complexities of real-world LLM applications.
takeaways: LLM agents in LangGraph autonomously process tasks by using state graphs to make decisions and interact with tools or APIs.

Follow along with the full video course to gain hands-on experience with LangGraph, including setting up workflows and building a LangGraph agent that can autonomously parse and send emails and interact with API services.
LangGraph builds on its parent library, LangChain, and allows you to build sophisticated workflows that can handle the complexities of real-world LLM applications.
